description: This file contains a shell script that defines a set of tests for verifying the behavior of the 'git submodule set-branch' command. It simulates creating repositories, configuring submodules, and running various commands to ensure the set-branch functionality works as expected.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the commands within it to succeed.

methods.name: test_cmp_config
methods.description: Compares the configuration value of a submodule setting in .gitmodules against an expected value.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or inputs to verify they are identical.
